question: On identical single frames, descriptions, sampled points and each source epoch100, what are the paired differences between the official last-layer 3EED Top-1 readout and frozen full R158?
primary: All 5942 previously registered ordinary directions. Separate design-weighted DEV1798 and recording-disjoint (relative to R158) TRAIN3072 checks. Never pool cohorts.
paired_input: Same B=1, canonical native comma spacing and suffix, original 16384 float32 sampled points from the identical fixed seed and same native A256. Legacy seeds from R158 for VAL, seed 0 for recording check. Exact candidates and point/text parity on VAL, matched recorded winners/PCA on unmodified recording rows. Recompute R158 for every changed normalization from the very same native forward without a new seed.

arms.official_span: Official last-layer BBF, temperature .07 token-softmax, binary native class/synonym span from annotation, torch descending argsort incl ties, native pred_size minimum 1e-6 as upstream main_utils, yaw zero in scoring frame. Category only, no GT coordinates for picking.
arms.native_text_only: Same native probabilities and sorting, established deployed first lexicon noun with all-content fallback, no target category and no RGB.
arms.prepared_axis: Full source-prepared RGB-language model argmax, original axes.
arms.prepared_pca: Same argmax plus frozen R155 yaw.
arms.r158_full: Full frozen same-source R91 matching, R158 overlap decision and R155 yaw, RGB and calibration, no target GT, zero updates.

prediction_separation: Freeze raw native outputs, pure-text mask and R158 endpoints before class-span map lookup. Seal all official winners before any new target box metrics. Benchmark-required class span confined to official readout. No tuning; official-ineligible expressions if any disclosed and deployment results kept.
metrics: Common upright oriented 3D IoU in native model axes, official GT preprocessing float32 first seven values, strict >.25 and >.50, paired threshold rescues/losses and mIoU with all positives and negatives, direction-equal macro; original per-input design weights on DEV only, all others uniform. Audit with independent OBB, validate real upstream evaluator readout. No geography/independent sample or parameter TTA claim.
paper: Published Table 2 is context only; compare local source checkpoints and identical inputs, not subtract from printed paper percentages.
compute_budget: One GPU sequential over 10812 registered directed records; source and target training zero. No external encoders or FINAL access. Previous raw sensor R158 endpoints reused after candidate/point checks wherever input is identical.
